newsitem.title: ITALY: De Benedetti details Cofide, Cir share dealings.
newsitem.headline: De Benedetti details Cofide, Cir share dealings.

text.p: During the month of September Carlo De Benedetti purchased 3,175 million ordinary shares in his family holding group Cofide, which in turn bought 6,572 million shares in industrial holding Cir.
These details were given in a statement to the Milan bourse, and include the purchase by Cofide of 600,000 Cir shares on September 20 which brought its shareholding up to 50.06 percent.
Cofide is headed by De Benedetti who owns 31.11 percent, while a shareholders syndicate controls 48.9 percent. Cir controls around 15 percent of Olivetti.
